title: Mitsubishi Electric MELSEC
summary: MELSEC controllers include the compact iQ-F (FX5) series and the modular iQ-R series, programmed with GX Works3.

sections.heading: Platforms
sections.body:
| Family | Role |
| --- | --- |
| MELSEC iQ-F (FX5) | Compact controllers for small machines |
| MELSEC iQ-R | Modular high-performance controllers |

sections.heading: Conventions worth knowing
sections.body: Devices such as X (inputs), Y (outputs), M (internal relays) and D (data registers) are addressed by number; on FX5 the X/Y devices are numbered in octal. Ladder is dominant; ST and FBD are available in GX Works3.
